seo.title: Privacy policy
seo.description: How arafatbin.com collects, uses and protects your personal data when you place an order, send a message or use the contact forms.

hero.title: Privacy policy
hero.text: What data this website collects and how it is used.

sections.heading: 1. Data I collect
paragraphs: When you use the contact or review form I receive the details you type in, such as your name, email and message.

When you place an order I keep the order ID, your name, phone number, email, the items, the total and the payment method in a private order database on Cloudflare, so you can follow the order on the Track order page. Only I can see these details; the tracking page shows only the status, items and total, and only to someone who has the order ID and your phone number or email.

sections.heading: 2. Analytics
paragraphs: This website uses Google Analytics and, when it is turned on, Microsoft Clarity to understand how visitors use it. Both use cookies and collect anonymous usage data such as pages viewed, clicks and scrolling. Clarity can record how a page is used, but text typed into forms is hidden and never recorded.
When it is turned on, Cloudflare Web Analytics counts page visits without cookies and without following you to other websites.

sections.heading: 3. How I use your data
list: To reply to your message or order
To deliver services and products you ordered
To show your review, only if you allow it

sections.heading: 4. Third-party services
paragraphs: Forms are delivered by Web3Forms. Links to WhatsApp, LinkedIn and Fiverr follow those services' own privacy policies.
The website and the order database are hosted by Cloudflare. When it is turned on, live chat is provided by tawk.to; what you write in the chat is kept by tawk.to so I can answer you.

sections.heading: 5. Data sharing
paragraphs: I do not sell or rent your personal data to anyone.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask me to show, correct or delete the data I hold about you by emailing contact@arafatbin.com.

sections.heading: 7. Changes
paragraphs: This policy may be updated. The date at the top shows the latest version.
